scoring_justification: Checker independently solves the MFA equations to recompute gold free-energy values and compares to agent's reported free energy; also checks transition crossing.

outputs.description: Table of reduced temperature t, sublattice magnetizations sigma_A/F, equilibrium strains epsilon_A/F, and free energy densities f_A/F for the antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phases. The checker will recompute the free energy RMSE against hidden gold values and verify the A→F phase transition crossing.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the main numerical result (Fig. 5) of the paper. The earlier critical‑temperature parameter scan is not required.

steps.description: Recompute free energy at probe temperatures by solving the MFA equations independently, compute RMSE between agent's f_A, f_F and gold, and score.
Verify that there exists a temperature in [1.2, 1.4] where f_F becomes less than f_A, indicating an A->F transition.
